text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.

angle_info.justification: Relatable story of individual spiritual growth and transformation

**Hook:** "What if love changed everything?"

**Context:** "For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, because He saw our potential to love Him back."

**Application:** "Your worth isn't defined by what you've done, but by how much you're loved."

**Call to action:** "Believe in His love and find eternal life."
